assumptions: Original contemporaneous report names Dallas-or-Miami2023second fallback. moves.label: Trade: De'Aaron Fox, Jordan McLaughlin, Sidy Cissoko, Zach Collins, Tre Jones and others
moves.description: De'Aaron Fox and Jordan McLaughlin were acquired by the San Antonio Spurs in exchange for Sidy Cissoko, Zach Collins, Tre Jones, a conditional 2025 1st round pick (CHI own), a 2025 2nd round pick (CHI own), a conditional 2023 1st round pick (CHA own), a 2027 1st round pick (SAN own), a conditional 2028 2nd round pick (DEN own) and a 2031 1st round pick (MIN own). Zach Collins, Kevin Huerter, Tre Jones, a conditional 2025 1st round pick (CHI own) and a TPE were acquired by the Chicago Bulls in exchange for Zach LaVine, a 2028 2nd round pick (SAC own) and a TPE. Sidy Cissoko, Zach LaVine, a 2025 2nd round pick (CHI own), a conditional 2023 1st round pick (CHA own), a 2027 1st round pick (SAN own), a conditional 2028 2nd round pick (DEN own), a 2028 2nd round pick (SAC own), a 2031 1st round pick (MIN own) and a TPE were acquired by the Sacramento Kings in exchange for De'Aaron Fox, Kevin Huerter, Jordan McLaughlin and a TPE.

moves.label: Trade: Anfernee Simons, Nikola Vucevic

moves.label: Trade: Dalen Terry, Guerschon Yabusele

player_coverage.injury_review_note: Source-reviewed dated major-absence corpus and current captured app injury overlays; targeted method review, not an exhaustive historical clinical archive.

assumptions: First-round forfeitures are excluded before the lottery. Under the new system, keep the remaining relegated teams’ No.12floor and origin-based repeat-pick restrictions. Second-round ordering uses the full30-origin counterfactual lottery. This forfeiture interaction is a modeling assumption pending a detailed NBA procedure.
For2030andlater, continue the latest announced lottery system; the NBA has not yet determined those rules.
Reported most-favorable DET-held2028right, top55protected; physicalDET56–60is already owedPHI and is never reassigned.
Top-N second-round protections use actual overall numbers, including a second-round selection atNo.30 after a first-round forfeiture.
Reconstructed v5 pick prices use the fixed current endpoint-trained model and the last archived strength/standings forecast dated 2026-10-25; legal rights are dated 2026-10-31.
Historical injury coverage uses reviewed major absence reports; it is not a complete archive of short-term medical reports.
Picks and original development-window production use the same year-four target; salaries are separate; older unsupported historical cohorts retain the archived production policy.
